import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p = params
    w = p[9]
    S = np.sin(w*t); C = np.cos(w*t)
    S2 = np.sin(2*w*t); C2 = np.cos(2*w*t)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*S + p[2]*C + p[3]*np.log(v) + p[4]*np.sqrt(v)*C
            + p[5]*np.cos(v)*C2 + p[6]*np.cos(v) + p[7]*np.cos(v)*S2
            + p[8]*np.sqrt(v)*S)
